description: Native Mistral AI LLM inference via Mistral's OpenAI-compatible API. Drop-in peer of openai_llm / anthropic_llm / gemini_llm / groq_llm. Mistral's wire format is identical to OpenAI's Chat Completions — swap in a Mistral API key and model name and existing OpenAI-client code works unchanged. For multi-vendor routing use litellm_inference_asset.

outputs.description: Upstream DataFrame with the LLM response column added (and optional _error column).

api_key_env_var.description: Env var holding the Mistral API key.
api_key_env_var.label: API Key Env Var

base_url.description: Mistral OpenAI-compatible base URL. Override only for proxies.
base_url.label: Base URL

text_model.label: Text Model
text_model.description: Common: mistral-large-latest, mistral-medium-latest, mistral-small-latest, open-mistral-nemo, codestral-latest, ministral-8b-latest, ministral-3b-latest

user_prompt_template.description: Template with {column} placeholders. Mutually exclusive with input_column.
user_prompt_template.label: User Prompt Template

input_column.description: Column whose value becomes the per-row prompt. Mutually exclusive with user_prompt_template.
input_column.label: Input Column

rate_limit_delay.description: Seconds to sleep between rows. Raise this if you hit Mistral's rate limits.
rate_limit_delay.label: Rate Limit Delay

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

partition_type.description: Partition type: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly', 'static', 'multi', 'dynamic', or None for unpartitioned.
partition_type.label: Partition Type

partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based partition types.
partition_start.label: Partition Start

partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'customer_a,customer_b,customer_c'.
partition_values.label: Partition Values

partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.
partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions

name: Mistral LLM
